mapper.select: with tempIds as ( select portfolio_id from PTL_PORTFOLIO where 1 = 1 ) select t2.*,info.parent_portfolio_id parentId from ( select t1.* from ( select t.*, row_number() over(partition by t.portfolio_id,t.profit_type order by t.cdate desc) rn from PL_TARGET_DB t where 1 = 1 and t.PORTFOLIO_ID in (select portfolio_id from tempIds) ) t1 where rn = 1 ) t2 left join PTL_PORTFOLIO info on info.portfolio_id = t2.portfolio_id where 1 = 1

select info.tareget_type_code, info.tareget_type_name, detail.tareget_code, detail.tareget_name, detail.is_default from TARGET_TYPE_INFO info INNER JOIN TARGET_DETAIL detail on info.tareget_type_code = detail.tareget_type_code where 1 = 1
and info.tareget_type_code in ('01','02','03')
and info.tareget_type_code in ('04','05','06','07')
select t.COLUMN_NAME taregetCode,t.DATA_TYPE taregetTypeCode from user_tab_columns t where table_name='PL_TARGET_DB'

select EFF_DATE cdate, yield from ( select EFF_DATE, t.CLOSE_PRICE yield from MST_EXPONENT_QUOTATION t where t.INT_RATE != null
AND (select t.vdate from PTL_PORTFOLIO t where t.portfolio_id = #{portfolioId}) >= EFF_DATE
AND MARKET_ID = #{marketId}
order by EFF_DATE desc ) where rownum = 1
select * from MST_INDEX_COMPONENT t where t.index_id = #{indexId}
